source_basis: Existing source_catalog.json building rectangle, floor count and floor height are retained. No real escalator or gym facility location was surveyed.

escalator.layout: One adjacent up/down pair at the east-side commercial lounge; actual upper-floor slab opening, continuous sloped support, guard rails and supported landings.
escalator.carrier: The unchanged player capsule rides StaticBody3D constant_linear_velocity conveyor surfaces. No teleport or collision mask bypass.
escalator.tread_visuals: Bounded loop of moving tread/nosing meshes and handrail seams above the smooth support; risers supply no collision.
escalator.pause: Room and conveyor animation obey scene pause; player physics is also paused.
escalator.scope: One game interior; original exterior source geometry and existing U stairs/lifts remain.

gym.mount: Production E validates same-level floor support, original capsule corridor, range and equipment line of sight. The 0.7–0.75m floor approach and use point are retained and checked for safe exit.
gym.seated_pose: Display-only seated avatar with original standing capsule maintained at the clear marker; visual machine saddle/frame is not a solid seat.
gym.exit: Fresh E; if original standing position/corridor is blocked, hold the safe seat, freeze time/work and retry on a fresh E after clearance.
gym.limits: Game activity measures only; no exercise physiology, actual hotel service or surveyed equipment inventory.
